europe_now.title: Ceuta migration crisis: Far-right govts 'ridiculously using these images' to stoke fear for votes
europe_now.summary: The Ceuta migration surge has become a political tool for far-right governments, exacerbating public fear and division. The EU has called for united action to address the border security challenges.
